QUESTIONS

Common questions.

Who can participate?+

EcoThon is open to all streams, including Arts and Diploma, for students at 12th-standard level and above. CADathon is only for Civil Engineering students.

Can we choose our own problem?+

No. Both themes use problems given at the event.

Which software should I install?+

For CADathon, pre-install your planning, design and analysis software. Ask a coordinator about accepted software.

How do we register as a team?+

3 or 4 members, including the team lead. Submit one registration per team. Pay once for the whole team: ₹750 for 3 members or ₹1,000 for 4 members. Add one transaction ID and payment proof in the form.

Will food be provided?+

Yes. Lunch and refreshments are included.

Do we get certificates?+

Physical certificates for all participants.

When does registration close?+

14th October 2026. Register as a team through the Google Form.
